{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial Bank of Korfo II''' was a [[Bank/Legends|bank]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[sentientologist]] [[Obo Rin]] maintained an account at the bank, which the Empire used to reimburse him for his expenses as he researched and wrote the ''[[Catalog of Intelligent Life in the Galaxy]]''.<ref name="GG4-1">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>
